subject: Portal checkpoint & sample proof request for Whistic onboarding
messages:
From: Samir Shah <samir@whistic.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-26T09:12:00Z
Subject: Whistic onboarding — initial checklist and sample evidence request

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for deciding to onboard Redwood to Whistic — excited to get you across the finish line. To help us pre-stage your profile and speed the QA pass, can you share a short set of sample artifacts mapped to SIG/CAIQ sections? Specifically we typically ask for: 

- A redacted SOC 2 Type II report (covering controls and scope)
- A current network diagram (high level, showing segmentation)
- A short CAIQ CSV or sample answers for authentication, encryption, and incident response

If you prefer we can accept a one-off upload to Whistic or a CSV import. I can also send an invite for a 15-minute handoff if that's easier.

Leaving a link to our onboarding guide here: https://app.whistic.com/onboarding-guide

Best,
Samir
Samir Shah
Onboarding Manager — Whistic

Attachment: onboarding-checklist.pdf (stub)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@whistic.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-26T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Whistic onboarding — initial checklist and sample evidence request

Samir — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Irene (security) and Marissa (portal ops) so we can coordinate the specific artifacts and the upload format. Quick notes from our side: 

- We can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II (Nov 2027) PDF and a sanitized network diagram.
- For CAIQ, we have an internal CSV export that covers the usual authentication/encryption/IR fields; we can trim it to a sample set if you need.
- Prefer a direct UI upload into the Whistic org (read-only access for your onboarding user) rather than bulk API imports for the sample pieces.

Irene/Marissa — can you confirm which items you can get to us by EOD Jul 28? Samir, if a 15-min sync is easiest, please propose windows and we'll pick one.

Thanks,
Jonas
VP, Partnerships — Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@whistic.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-27T08:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Whistic onboarding — initial checklist and sample evidence request

Hi all — quick inventory from engineering/security on what we can stage now and the recommended export format: 

Available to upload (redacted):
- SOC2_Redacted_2027.pdf (scope: infra + platform services)
- redwood-network-diagram.png (png, obfuscated VLANs, shows peering & internet boundary)
- sample-caiq-answers.csv (CSV with columns: question_id, answer, evidence_reference)
- access-list.txt (service accounts with read-only proof artifacts)

Notes / asks:
- Please confirm whether Whistic prefers a UI upload vs. a CSV Q&A import. If UI: we'll upload the three artifacts and attach short notes mapping to SIG categories (auth, encryption, IR).
- If you need S3 presigned manifest for bulk ingest, we can generate temporary presigned URLs (we'll need a short-lived upload bucket and the intended object keys).
- We will redact any customer-identifying log samples before sending; SOC2 will be redacted to control-level detail only.

Action items I can own:
1) Prepare SOC2 redacted PDF and network diagram (ETA: 2028-07-28 17:00 UTC)
2) Export sample-caiq-answers.csv (ETA: 2028-07-28 12:00 UTC)
3) Stand by for a 15-min handoff if you want to confirm the mapping live.

Marissa — are you able to provision a temporary "onboarding@whistic.com" read-only identity in our Whistic org, or would you prefer Samir to accept our upload link?

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference

Attachment: internal-evidence-index.txt (stub)

From: Samir Shah <samir@whistic.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-28T14:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Whistic onboarding — initial checklist and sample evidence request

Thanks everyone — that plan works. We're scheduled for a 15-min handoff on Jul 28 at 16:00 UTC (invite attached). Two quick confirmations so we can pre-stage the profile: 

1) Upload method: please upload the SOC2 redacted PDF and network diagram via the Whistic UI (we'll use onboarding@whistic.com as the recipient). If you prefer the S3 presign route, send the manifest link and we'll pull.
2) CAIQ sample: CSV is perfect — we'll run a quick mapping job on our side.

I attached: whistic-invite.ics and upload-instructions.md (small stub with preferred filenames + recommended metadata). I'll also link our onboarding ticket: https://hubspot.com/deal/WH-8421 so you can reference the ticket number in file names (helps our QA).

Goal: once the three artifacts are in, we'll run a scoped QA and come back with any clarifying questions (usually under 48 hours). Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Samir
Onboarding Manager — Whistic

Attachments: whistic-invite.ics, upload-instructions.md
